/* file : PredictionMapper.xml, id : getPopupModelList */
SELECT A.* , (SELECT DTL_CD_NM FROM TB_CODE_DTL T WHERE T.DEL_YN = 'N' AND T.GRP_CD = 'RESAMP_TYPE' AND T.DTL_CD = A.RESMPL_INTVL_TP) RESMPL_INTVL_TP_NM FROM TB_MODEL A JOIN TB_MODEL_FILES B ON A.MODEL_SEQ = B.MODEL_SEQ AND B.REF_TP = 'MODEL' AND B.DEL_YN = 'N' WHERE A.DEL_YN = 'N' AND A.USE_YN = 'Y' AND A.MODEL_STATUS = 'DONE' ORDER BY REG_DT DESC
/* file : PredictionMapper.xml, id : getModelInfo */ SELECT * FROM TB_MODEL WHERE MODEL_SEQ = #{modelSeq} AND USE_YN = 'Y' AND DEL_YN = 'N'

/* file : PredictionMapper.xml, id : getModelParams */ SELECT *, (SELECT MODEL_PARAMS_ITEM FROM TB_MODEL_META_ITEM B WHERE B.MODEL_ALGRM_SEQ = #{modelAlgrmSeq} AND A.MODEL_PARAMS_ITEM_SEQ = B.MODEL_PARAMS_ITEM_SEQ) MODEL_ALGRM_NM FROM TB_MODEL_PARAMS A WHERE MODEL_SEQ = #{modelSeq} AND USE_YN = 'Y' AND DEL_YN = 'N'
/* file : PredictionMapper.xml, id : getModelFiles */ SELECT * FROM TB_MODEL_FILES WHERE MODEL_SEQ = #{modelSeq} AND USE_YN = 'Y' AND DEL_YN = 'N'
/* file : PredictionMapper.xml, id : getModelColumns */ SELECT * FROM TB_MODEL_COLUMN WHERE MODEL_SEQ = #{modelSeq} AND USE_YN = 'Y' AND DEL_YN = 'N'

/* file : PredictionMapper.xml, id : getInsertSimulationViewResult */ SELECT CONCAT(B.FILE_PATH,'/', B.STRG_FILE_NM) AUGMENT_FILE_PATH, FILE_SEQ AUGMENT_FILE_SEQ FROM TB_AUGMENT A LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_AUGMENT_MODEL_FILES B ON A.AUGMENT_SEQ = B.REF_SEQ AND B.REF_TP = 'AUGMENT' AND B.DEL_YN = 'N' WHERE A.DEL_YN = 'N' AND A.USE_YN = 'Y' AND A.AUGMENT_SEQ = #{augmentSeq}

/* file : PredictionMapper.xml, id : getSimulation */ SELECT A.*, B.MODEL_SEQ, B.MODEL_NM,B.MODEL_ALGRM_SEQ, (SELECT FILE_SEQ FROM TB_AUGMENT_MODEL_FILES T WHERE T.REF_SEQ = A.AUGMENT_SEQ AND REF_TP = 'AUGMENT' AND DEL_YN='N' AND USE_YN='Y') AUGMENT_FILE_SEQ FROM TB_AUGMENT A LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_MODEL B ON A.MODEL_SEQ = B.MODEL_SEQ AND B.DEL_YN = 'N' AND B.USE_YN = 'Y' WHERE A.DEL_YN = 'N' AND A.USE_YN = 'Y' AND A.AUGMENT_SEQ = #{augmentSeq}

/* file : PredictionMapper.xml, id : getSimulationUserSeq */ SELECT A.*, B.MODEL_SEQ, B.MODEL_NM,B.MODEL_ALGRM_SEQ FROM TB_AUGMENT A LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_MODEL B ON A.MODEL_SEQ = B.MODEL_SEQ AND B.DEL_YN = 'N' AND B.USE_YN = 'Y' WHERE A.DEL_YN = 'N' AND A.USE_YN = 'Y' AND A.AUGMENT_SEQ = #{augmentSeq} AND (A.REG_USER_SEQ = #{loginUserSeq} OR A.RLS_YN = 'Y')

/* file : PredictionMapper.xml, id : getModelFileInfo */ select A.*, B.PRCS_LEVEL ,B.INDEX_TRGT_COL from TB_MODEL_FILES A JOIN TB_MODEL B ON A.MODEL_SEQ = B.MODEL_SEQ AND A.REF_TP = B.PRCS_LEVEL AND B.DEL_YN = 'N' AND B.USE_YN = 'Y' WHERE A.DEL_YN = 'N' AND A.USE_YN = 'Y' AND B.MODEL_SEQ = #{modelSeq}

/* file : AugmentModelMapper.xml, id : getAlgolithmCodeList */ SELECT DTL_CD , DTL_CD_NM , REF_CD , REF_CLASS , REF_VALUE , ORDBY FROM TB_CODE_DTL WHERE GRP_CD = 'MODEL_TERM' AND DEL_YN = 'N' AND USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY ORDBY, DTL_CD_NM
